verses.text: God, show that I'm in the right. Take up my case against a nation that turns away from you. Rescue me from people who lie and do evil.
You're the God who gives me strength. Why have you turned me away? Why do I go around grieving under my enemy's oppression?
Send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me all the way to your holy hill, to your tents. ✨
Then I'll go to God's altar, to God, my greatest joy. I'll praise you on the harp, God, my God.
Why are you so down, my soul? Why are you so restless inside me? Put your hope in God! I'll praise him again, my Savior, my helper, and my God.
